What is the return policy?

Our return policy allows you to return products under specific conditions. You may return a product if:

1. It is sealed, unopened, unused, and in its original condition.
2. The return request is made on the same day of delivery or within the exchange/refund timeline specified by the seller.

Please note that requests for exchanges or returns will not be accepted after the day following delivery, unless the product falls under a category with a longer return period. If a refund has been processed, you are requested to dispose of the product.

If you have any further questions or need assistance, feel free to ask!

How is a refund for a cash-on-delivery order credited?

For cash-on-delivery orders, the refund value will be credited to your Zepto Cash account in the form of a Zepto Gift Card. This is due to the absence of a source account for such transactions. Please note that these Zepto Gift Cards are classified as prepaid payment instruments and are subject to the applicable terms and conditions. If you have any further questions, feel free to ask!
